Variety-style text overlays with backslashes appear around her as she speaks. (6) A creative visual effect appears where cartoon pineapple graphics are overlaid behind the woman's head like a crown. She continues her explanation, unfazed by the graphic, maintaining her informative and friendly demeanor while the camera remains static. (7) The final phase shows the woman concluding her advice. A brief cutaway shows hands placing a ceramic bowl into a microwave. She finishes by speaking directly to the viewers with a calm, helpful expression, emphasizing safety tips for using kitchen tools.
